items.source: Advanced customization of the CreatorProperty instances customized to additionally register them with the ValueInstantiator backing the BeanDeserializerModifier. This is necessary as the standard customization does not propagate into the initial object construction as the CreatorProperty instances for that are looked up via the ValueInstantiator and the property model behind those is not undergoing the customization currently (Jackson 2.9.9).
items.translation: 对 `CreatorProperty` 实例进行高级自定义，使其额外注册到为 `BeanDeserializerModifier` 提供支持的 `ValueInstantiator` 中。这是必要的，因为标准自定义不会传播到初始对象构建过程中：用于该过程的 `CreatorProperty` 实例是通过 `ValueInstantiator` 查找的，而其背后的属性模型当前并未接受此自定义（Jackson 2.9.9）。
